claims.evidence: Single static photo shows only exterior; no power-on, audio, or key-press evidence is visible or provided.

risks.risk: Keyboard may not power on or may have dead/stuck keys
risks.proof: Video clip of unit powering on and each key/octave being pressed with audible sound
Photo of the adapter/cable alongside the unit

risks.risk: Speaker or audio output damage (grille shows dust/stains, possible water or wear damage)
risks.proof: Audio/video clip demonstrating clear sound from built-in speakers

risks.risk: LCD screen or control panel buttons may be unresponsive or display faults
risks.proof: Close-up video of screen lit up while navigating menus/buttons

risks.risk: No accessories (stand, sustain pedal, bag) included despite possible buyer expectation
risks.proof: Photo showing accessories included in the sale
risks.if_unproven: priced as keyboard only, no accessories

risks.risk: Hidden cosmetic or structural damage not visible from this single angled photo
risks.proof: Additional photos from multiple angles including underside and back ports
risks.if_unproven: priced as condition unknown, assume cosmetic wear plus possible hidden damage

proof_requests: Video of the keyboard powering on and producing sound from multiple keys
Close-up photo of the power adapter/cable if included
Photo/video of the LCD screen lit and responsive to button presses
Additional photos from front, back, and underside showing ports and full condition
Photo of any included accessories (stand, pedal, bag)
response.reason: Identity (Yamaha-style PSR-550 keyboard) is settled by the witness, but the seller's 'working perfectly' claim is unverifiable from a single static photo, so the item must be priced at worst case (functionality, audio, and accessories unproven) until supporting proof is provided.
